caption.en: A developer and a product manager use a calendar and a screen to clarify a date filter.
caption.zh: 开发者与产品经理借助日历和屏幕，用具体例子确认日期筛选的需求。

description.en: A developer and a product manager use a calendar and a screen to clarify a date filter.
description.zh: 开发者与产品经理借助日历和屏幕，用具体例子确认日期筛选的需求。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could you give me an example of how the filter should work?
dialogue.zh: 你能举个例子说明这个筛选功能应该如何工作吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Choose a date range, and show only records from that period.
dialogue.zh: 选择一个日期范围，只显示这段时间内的记录。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's mark the dates on this calendar and check the screen.
dialogue.zh: 我们在这张日历上标出日期，再看看屏幕。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good idea. We'll include records from both the start and end dates.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。开始日期和结束日期当天的记录都要包含在内。

dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 用具体输入和边界条件确认筛选逻辑。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers discuss a form at a desk. A desktop monitor in the center shows abstract date input boxes and three blank result rows, with no text or numbers. On the front left of the tabletop is a small upright desk calendar: a spiral binding, blank header, and a clear empty rectangular day grid without letters or numbers. One coworker points toward the calendar, the other toward the screen. Keep the entire calendar and monitor screen unobstructed and separate.
